versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.2 of img-gen-fork

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No new features, fixes, or updates introduced.

- Skill is now a placeholder with no image generation functionality.
- All documentation and API usage instructions have been removed.
- Users are redirected to install the official GLM-Image-Generation skill.
- The CLI script for image generation has been removed.
- New readme provides installation instructions for the recommended skill.

GLM-Image Generation Skill v0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Generate high-quality images from text prompts using the ZhiPu GLM-Image API.
- Supports various aspect ratios, HD mode, watermark control, and built-in content filtering.
- Provides clear instructions for API key setup and usage via CLI.
- Enforces strict use of the official API; no alternative or fallback image generation methods.
- Includes detailed output rules and recommendations for displaying and saving generated images.
